_comment: phobiCCCP tool library: the Carbide 3D cutter catalogue with per-material feeds & speeds.
Lengths in mm, feeds in mm/min, rpm, stepdown in mm, stepover in % of diameter.
'uncertain' on a tool: catalogue number / spec written from memory, not verified against the shop page.
'guess' on a feeds entry: NOT a remembered Carbide Create default — a conservative value; check before cutting.
Remembered CC defaults (imperial chart): #201 softwood 18000 rpm / 75 ipm / 15 ipm plunge / 0.060" DOC (= 1905 / 381 / 1.524 mm, matches the CC 853 sample file);
hardwood 60 ipm / 0.050"; acrylic 40 ipm / 0.030"; HDPE 60 ipm / 0.050"; aluminium 10000 rpm / 20 ipm / 5 ipm / 0.010".
'price' on a tool: per bit, in 'currency' (USD unless given); 'price_note' says what was actually paid (pack size, shop).
'bought' on a tool: bits per pack as bought; the stock count a fresh install starts with (edited in the library dialog, kept in settings).
